characters.voiceActor: Unknown}} Alan McClean is a character appearing on the promotional Lifeinvader website for GTA V. ==Background== McClean is a retired marine. He is divorced, and apparently was abusive towards his children. McClean also wrote a book called Hitting Kids Works Wonders, and opened a boot camp based on it. He is interested in "parental discipline done right", spelunking, dune buggies, Roman history, gladiator books and Marines. ==Plot== Alan McClean can be heard on The Fernando Show on West Coast Talk Radio, after Sue Murry gives a negative opinion on his book. He calls in and threatens to hit both her and her child, stating that she sounds like she needs "a spanking by a marine" and he is "the marine to do it" before promptly hanging up on her. His advertisements can also be heard on The Lowdown 91.1. ==Influence== McClean might be based on Glenn Ellison, a former US marine who runs a discipline camp in Jacksonville, Florida, and has been featured in an episode of World's Strictest Parents and a BBC documentary. Another possible influence for McClean is John Rosemond, a parenting advice blogger and founder of the Leadership Parenting Institute based in New Bern, NC, whose work has been heavily promoted by political news publications such as PragerU and BlazeTV. Like McClean, Rosemond has also expressed support for the use of physical discipline tactics on children. ==Gallery== {{Gallery |AlanMcClean-GTAV-Promo1.jpg|Alan McClean on Lifeinvader. |AlanMcClean-GTAV-Promo2.jpg|"Got a new phone, damn it"

characters.voiceActor: Unknown}} The unnamed Art Student is a minor character appearing in GTA V and GTA Online. ==Background== She is a young Caucasian female that appears as a generic pedestrian in Los Santos and is available to play in Director Mode as one of the Uptown female actors. This particular combination of blonde shoulder length hair, choker pendant necklace, brown lace-necked sleeveless mini-dress with a denim waistcoat, black pants and knee-high, high-heeled light brown boots is the default appearance but the generic pedestrian model can spawn with many varieties of hairstyle and clothing. These can be cycled through in Director Mode using the change appearance option. Being a student, she can appear around University of San Andreas, Los Santos during the day and being a member of the Uptown group means she can also appear anywhere from Morningwood to Downtown Vinewood, particularly at night. Her appearance will always be randomized combinations of hair and outfit so the chances of seeing the exact default combination are greatly reduced. ==Plot== ===Grand Theft Auto V=== She appears in several Switch Scenes with Franklin Clinton. In these scripted appearances her appearance will always be the default outfit and hairstyle. Before Hotel Assassination, Franklin will be leaving the Little Teapot on Hawick Avenue and the student will be walking past. There are three variations of this scene, but Franklin's lines suggest he tries to pick her up. The girl will turn to acknowledge Franklin but doesn't speak before the player gains control of Franklin. After the Hotel Assassination, Franklin takes possession of 3671 Whispymound Drive and he can be found sitting on the couch talking to an unknown party inviting them around to the house, possibly the art student.
